CommunityApplications.Profile: Maintainer repository for the Mosquitto (Eclipse Mosquitto 2.x) MQTT broker Docker template for Unraid. A maintained alternative to the spants/mqtt template (last updated 2020, Mosquitto 1.x — cannot read Mosquitto 2.x persistent databases). Supports MQTT protocol 5 (required by modern Home Assistant), host networking, and a standard /config layout.
